policy.tuning: None. Freeze query definitions, model-generated labels and criteria before comparative rankings; held-out queries run last.
policy.ground_truth: Actual pilot preview inspection plus source identity and verified metadata; captions excluded from labeling inputs. Model-generated labels remain provisional until explicit owner review.
policy.reference: Deterministic central crop with original background/pixels; verify no byte-identical indexed input and remove parent-image hashes before aggregation. Report same-asset cross-view and other-asset relevance separately; not an independent photo domain test.
policy.negative: Count any returned candidate as an operational false positive; separately count explicit strong claims. Weak labeling does not count as abstention.
policy.tokens: Exact serialized characters and ceil(characters/4) estimator; additionally count with the pinned EmbeddingGemma tokenizer, explicitly a surrogate rather than Codex billing/context tokens.
policy.human_gate: No final quality pass or step 7 without owner relevance review and explicit pilot approval.
policy.latency: Warm queries include inference, source/preview hash checks, ranking and compact serialization; tokenizer measurement/evidence writes excluded. P95 uses nearest-rank. Cold includes fresh process initialization; OS disk cache not purged.
